# Authoritative dependency metadata (issue #503).
#
# For C/C++ there is no ecosystem lockfile. Resolution order is exact
# `# gazelle:resolve` mapping, then the local rule index, then the exact
# `# gazelle:dx_ignore_import` exception, else fail with actionable context.
# Its module index is not the consumer's resolved graph: the gazelle_cc
# module index never substitutes for local plus mapping resolution.
# Generated headers have no checked-in owner and require an exact resolve
# mapping; generation never infers a generated producer.

order: exact # gazelle:resolve mapping
order: local rule index
order: exact # gazelle:dx_ignore_import exception
order: else fail with actionable context
its module index is not the consumer's resolved graph
authoritative metadata is the local rule index plus exact mappings, never the module index
generated headers have no checked-in owner and require an exact resolve mapping
inferred generated producer rejected
every unknown or ambiguous literal reference fails with actionable context
